audit: Full-source semantic review of design, operations and marketing workflow components
method: Read complete local SKILL.md text, including scope exclusions, prerequisites, methods, output contracts, examples and limits. Compare actual task and step handoffs. This is semantic review, not an execution test. All proposed spec edits were sent to the workflow author; this reviewer edits no specs or licensed component sources.
release_status: Semantic review complete for exported domain workflows and agent branch dependencies. No open component-scope mismatches. Runtime inputs, tools, authorizations and missing-evidence rules remain explicit prerequisites; this audit does not certify executed outputs.
